import hashlib,json,os,runpy,shutil,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from statistics import median
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BUILD=ROOT/'build/lazy-errors'
OUT=ROOT/'benchmarks/results/2026-10-09-lazy-errors.json'
B=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'benchmarks/run'),run_name='benchmark_helpers')
A=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'benchmarks/ablate'),run_name='ablation_helpers')
C=runpy.run_path(str(ROOT/'benchmarks/chibi'),run_name='chibi_helpers')
CHEZ=B['chez_runtime'](SimpleNamespace(snail_only=False,chez=os.environ['CHEZ']))
CHIBI=C['chibi_runtime'](os.environ.get('CHIBI','chibi-scheme'))
REPS=A['REPETITIONS']


def freeze():
    previous=json.loads((ROOT/'build/runtime-v3/frozen.json').read_text())['new']
    sources=A['source_state']()
    changed={n for n in sources if sources[n]!=previous['source_sha256'].get(n)}
    assert changed=={'runtime/src/vm.rs'},changed
    old=Path('/tmp/snail-vm-before-lazy-errors.rs')
    assert B['fingerprint'](old)==previous['source_sha256']['runtime/src/vm.rs']
    patch=subprocess.run(['diff','-u',str(old),str(ROOT/'runtime/src/vm.rs')],text=True,capture_output=True).stdout
    report={'complete':False,'before':previous,'after':{'source_sha256':sources,'builds':[]},
            'patch':patch,'chez':CHEZ,'chibi':CHIBI,'samples':[],'summaries':[],
            'measurement_script':Path(__file__).read_text(),
            'configuration':'ordinary release, no LTO; unchanged saved LLVM per program; exact three eager error strings made lazy',
            'protocol':'Build all first, warm every participant once; four rounds alternate before/after order and position around Chez/Chibi references. CPU/memory16 repetitions, I/O4, GC16. Chibi omitted for GC. Internal timers exclude compilation/startup.'}
    for name in REPS:
        module=B['CompiledModule'](B['BUILD']/(name+'.ll'),B['input_metadata'](name))
        expected=next(b['ir_sha256'] for b in previous['builds'] if b['program']==name)
        assert B['fingerprint'](module.path)==expected
        B['chez_executable'](name,CHEZ,True)
        if name!='gc': C['chibi_program'](name,CHIBI,True)
        for target in ['native','wasm']:
            artifact=B['build_executable'](name,module,target)
            path=BUILD/'bin'/target/artifact.name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(artifact,path)
            B['record_artifact'](name,path,module.inputs)
            report['after']['builds'].append({'program':name,'target':target,'path':str(path),
                'artifact_sha256':B['fingerprint'](path),'ir_sha256':expected,'command':B['cargo_command'](target)})
    assert sources==A['source_state']()
    (BUILD/'frozen.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('LAZY ERRORS FROZEN',flush=True)


def executable(report,name,target,variant):
    b=next(b for b in report[variant]['builds'] if b['program']==name and b['target']==target)
    path=Path(b['path']);B['verify_artifact'](name,path)
    assert B['fingerprint'](path)==b['artifact_sha256']
    return B['Executable'](variant,target,path,tuple(B['execution_command'](path,target)))


def measure():
    report=json.loads((BUILD/'frozen.json').read_text())
    for name,count in REPS.items():
        for target in ['native','wasm']:
            group=[executable(report,name,target,v) for v in ['before','after']]
            group.append(B['chez_executable'](name,CHEZ,True))
            if name!='gc': group.append(C['chibi_program'](name,CHIBI,True))
            for item in group:B['run_sample'](name,item,count,False)
            rotated=group[2:]+group[:2]
            schedules=[group,list(reversed(group)),rotated,list(reversed(rotated))]
            rows=[]
            for index,order in enumerate(schedules):
                for position,item in enumerate(order):
                    row=B['run_sample'](name,item,count,False)
                    row.update(comparison_target=target,sample=index+1,position=position+1)
                    rows.append(row)
            times={v:[r['elapsed_ms'] for r in rows if r['implementation']==v]
                   for v in dict.fromkeys(r['implementation'] for r in rows)}
            medians={v:median(t) for v,t in times.items()}
            summary={'program':name,'target':target,'median_ms':medians,
                     'range_ms':{v:[min(t),max(t)] for v,t in times.items()},
                     'before_over_after':medians['before']/medians['after'],
                     'after_over_chez':medians['after']/medians['chez']}
            if 'chibi' in medians:summary['after_over_chibi']=medians['after']/medians['chibi']
            report['samples'].extend(rows);report['summaries'].append(summary)
            OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(summary,flush=True)
    report['complete']=True
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')


(freeze if sys.argv[1]=='build' else measure)()
configuration: ordinary release, no LTO; unchanged saved LLVM per program; exact three eager error strings made lazy
protocol: Build all first, warm every participant once; four rounds alternate before/after order and position around Chez/Chibi references. CPU/memory16 repetitions, I/O4, GC16. Chibi omitted for GC. Internal timers exclude compilation/startup.
